Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University vs DIT University is a Dehradun M.Pharm comparison. Neither college has a placement row here.

sections.heading: Dev Bhoomi vs DIT University for M.Pharm: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Dev Bhoomi Uttarakhand University if you want a GPAT-listed M.Pharm in pharmacology or pharmaceutics, with a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹1 lakh, after official confirmation.
Choose DIT University if you want recorded year tuition of ₹1.50 lakh for the same two streams, and a NIRF 2025 Pharmacy rank of 83 on our records.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Dev Bhoomi we hold ₹1 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for M.Pharm Pharmacology and M.Pharm Pharmaceutics. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official programme total.
For DIT University we hold year tuition of ₹1.50 lakh for the same two streams. Confirm the official DIT notice, because tuition may not include every head.
Check the current circulars on dbuu.ac.in and dituniversity.edu.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither college has a placement row on this page for M.Pharm.
Ask both campuses for an official postgraduate pharmacy placement or internship note if outcomes are central to your decision.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Dev Bhoomi is listed with GPAT. DIT University has no exam mapped on this page. Confirm each university's current official M.Pharm admission note.
On our records, DIT University has NIRF Pharmacy ranks of 83 in 2025 and 81 in 2024, recorded against M.Pharm. Dev Bhoomi has no rank row here. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, as private universities, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
Both list pharmacology and pharmaceutics. Visit the labs and read the official offer letter for the exact fee and stipend rules.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Dev Bhoomi if the GPAT-listed route and the recorded ₹1 lakh year fee fit you, after official confirmation.
Pick DIT University if the NIRF 2025 Pharmacy rank of 83 and the recorded ₹1.50 lakh year tuition are acceptable, after official confirmation.
This page has no M.Pharm placement data to break the tie.
